where.screen_path: /login (Fresh shell), / (Today carousel + Memories + Streak), /settings (Appearance section), People tab (Crew bubbles)

what.summary: Shipped 6 of 9 Fresh young-adult-friendly theme roadmap cuts in one aggregated session: foundation tokens + Appearance toggle (1), device-level theme + Fresh landing surface (2), Stories-style Today carousel (3), thumb-reach FAB + Memories anniversary strip (4), Crew avatar bubbles + connections extract (8), streak indicator + Memories/Streaks toggles (9). Six commits, all four gates green at every commit. Cuts 5 (onboarding rewrite), 6 (Sage persona activation), 7 (share cards + Quick-share presets) deferred to dedicated sessions because each requires deep grounding in adjacent code I have not yet read end-to-end.

why.text: Operator-authored direction: 'make a younger audience fall in love with it. Match current color trends and styles. Don't go lazy.' The 2026-05-24 Fresh theme + IA roadmap brief translated that into nine bounded cuts; this session executed six. Architectural pattern: every Fresh-specific component ships as a parallel file behind theme gates, Classic stays untouched, lazy-loaded so Classic operators never pay Fresh bytes.

outcome.notes: [P-CUT-1] ✓ Tailwind fresh-* tokens via CSS variables + useTheme hook + prefs.theme field + Settings Appearance toggle (commit 434147a). [P-CUT-2] ✓ Device-level localStorage theme mirror + bootstrapDeviceTheme synchronous pre-render + FreshLoginShell + aurora-drift CSS background (commit 46b63dd). [P-CUT-3] ✓ resolvedTheme threaded through WalletContext + FreshTodayCarousel snap-x stories pattern + FreshTodayCard with anchor edge-glow + JournalTabRouter dispatcher (commit a286dd3). [P-CUT-4] ✓ useScrollDirection hook + FreshComposeFAB thumb-reach pair + FreshMemoriesStrip with per-day localStorage dismiss + findMemoryEntries pure helper; four modal renders compacted in HomeScreen to stay under 800-line hard limit (commit 3b0d17c). [P-CUT-5] DEFERRED — onboarding rewrite is the largest architectural change, requires inverting the existing auth flow to hold volatile pre-sign-in journal text and bind it at session-bind time; deserves a dedicated session with full grounding in WalletProvider's phase machine. [P-CUT-6] DEFERRED — Sage persona activation depends on the persona framework wiring and the deferred bot brief. [P-CUT-7] DEFERRED — share cards depend on ShareProofModal which I have not read end-to-end. [P-CUT-8] ✓ identicon.ts FNV-1a-based avatar seeds + FreshCrew bubble row + ClassicConnections extracted from HomeScreen (commit 747cf83). [P-CUT-9] ✓ computeStreak pure math + FreshStreakIndicator chip + prefs.streaksEnabled and prefs.memoriesEnabled flags + Fresh extras toggle group in AppearanceSection (commit c649d61). [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: Cuts 5/6/7 read individually as 'one session each' rather than 'all three in one' — onboarding inversion alone is a full session's worth of grounding.

next: Pick up Cut 5 (Fresh onboarding rewrite — compose-before-login state machine) in a dedicated session. Read WalletProvider's phase machine end-to-end first; the inversion of pre-vs-post-sign-in state is the architectural crux.
